A reference copy of the application catalog, for the tests and the FreeBSD end-to-end test. The source of truth is
`main/jailops-apps/apps/` of the packages repository (jailops/jailops-packages), released as the `jailops-apps`
package with its own version. This copy is refreshed by hand when the catalog changes shape (a new field, a new
category, a new kind of app); a definition changed or added only there needs nothing here.
